answer: Vouch-slot bond: a newcomer docks at the wharf and takes one of three voucher slots; the voucher locks 70 credits, signing a key-bound receipt in the lagoon ledger. Each epoch the zephyr beacon samples 5% of them for a fresh zephyr reading; a reused or rented reading slashes both bonds, voids the voucher's slots. First identity costs 38, the kth 38+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,035,000 for a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 38 once, keeps its bond.
